facts.text: Trailing-twelve-month revenue is ₹22,001 cr, +18% on the prior twelve months.
Trailing-twelve-month PAT is ₹1,909 cr, +19% on the prior twelve months.
Sep 2026 quarter: revenue ₹5,873 cr (+22% YoY), PAT ₹468 cr (+26% YoY), operating margin 18.0%.
Revenue has compounded at 28% over 10 years, 51% over 5 and 35% over 3; the last twelve months (+18%) are running behind the 3-year pace.
Profit has compounded faster than revenue over 3 years (71% vs 35%): operating leverage is working.
Quarterly revenue growth has accelerated over the last four quarters: +15% → +19% → +18% → +22% YoY.
Operating margin is steady at 18.0% (16.9% a year ago).
Annual operating margin has ranged from 13% to 19% over five years; the latest year (19%) sits at the top of that range.
Borrowings are ₹2,328 cr against equity of ₹7,769 cr: debt/equity 0.30× (was 1.72× in Mar 2023).
Operating profit plus other income covers interest 23.9× over the last twelve months.
The cash conversion cycle has shortened to 36 days from 55 in Mar 2023 (inventory days 105 → 74, payable days 51 → 39).
Promoters hold 37.0%, unchanged over a year.
Over 5 years, ₹6,331 cr of operating cash came from ₹10,245 cr of operating profit: 62% conversion; against PAT of ₹5,161 cr that is 1.2×.
Free cash flow was negative in 1 of the last 5 years; cumulative ₹2,904 cr, latest year ₹931 cr.
Capex ran at 9% of revenue in Mar 2026, about ₹1,737 cr (averaged 4% over the three years before).
